provenance.observation: derived case-role sequence widened by one distinguished symbol per VERB and AUX token in surface order; lemma, feats and all token forms withheld
provenance.type_label_source: sentence-final punctuation token form: '.' declarative, '?' interrogative. PUNCT tokens emit nothing and a VERB or AUX contributes its UPOS only, so the label source cannot appear in the observation stream; both are asserted per sentence at build time by ailm.levels.widened.assert_widened_disjointness
provenance.usability_rule: a sentence is usable when its final punctuation names one of the two modeled types and it contributes at least 2 widened symbols. The shipped case-only artifact instead requires that many case-bearing tokens, so the two populations are nested rather than equal (decision 112)
provenance.split: document-index stride over authenticated # newdoc id values, before type and length filtering; the same partition the shipped case artifact inherits (decision 85)
provenance.document_identity_source: # newdoc id comments from the authenticated CoNLL-U source
provenance.case_label_source: ailm.cases derived heuristic — a research claim, not ground truth (decisions 16 and 84); the widened arm inherits its label uncertainty on the eight case symbols, while the two added symbols are UD UPOS tags and carry the corpus's own annotation uncertainty instead
provenance.registered_in: docs/decisions.md entry 112 — a development-session specification, not a confirmatory registration
